# Nivoram

Nivoram is a premium Indian home décor and gifting brand specialising in
999 silver coated and gold coated home décor, decorative showpieces, spiritual
pieces and thoughtful gifting. The site is an enquiry-led brand showcase —
pricing, availability and specifications are shared on enquiry rather than
checked out online.

## Pages

- / — brand home: hero with tagline search, collections, bestsellers, occasions, why-nivoram, corporate gifting, customer reviews
- /shop — the complete product catalogue (59 pieces), filterable by occasion: weddings, housewarming, festive, return gifts, corporate and decor
- /shop/new-arrivals — pieces explicitly marked new by the studio (5 marked)
- /shop/bestsellers — pieces explicitly marked as bestsellers (6 marked)
- /collections — overview of the five curated collections
- /collections/sacred-elegance — silver-tone idols and pooja accents
- /collections/statement-decor — sculptural showpieces, vases and candelabra
- /collections/timeless-accents — compotes, bowls and table accents (redirect)
- /collections/frames-keepsakes — ornate frames and keepsake boxes (redirect)
- /collections/auspicious-living — auspicious motifs for everyday spaces
- /collections/divine-grace — devotional idols and sets
- /collections/thoughtful-gifting — the gifting edit
- /gift-finder — three-question gift recommendation quiz
- /gifts/weddings — wedding and anniversary gifting
- /gifts/housewarming — housewarming gifting
- /gifts/festive — festive gifting
- /gifts/return — return gifts and favours
- /corporate-gifting — bulk and business gifting with enquiry form
- /our-story — the brand story
- /why-nivoram — brand values and approach
- /craftsmanship — approach to silver-tone finishes and care
- /contact — enquiries via form, email and WhatsApp
- /contact/custom-orders — custom order and bespoke requirement enquiries
- /faqs — frequently asked questions
- /journal — editorial pieces (gifting guides and care notes)
- /products/<slug> — individual product pages, all linked from the sitemap
- A product search lives in the site header (name, SKU and collection matching)

## Content notes

- All pieces are price on enquiry; specifications not yet verified render
  as "on request".
- Nivoram pieces are 999 silver coated / gold coated (silver-tone), not
  solid silver; product pages state material details only where verified.
- Enquiries: WhatsApp +91 77605 11222 (wa.me/917760511222), email
  info@nivoram.com, Instagram @nivoram.shop. Homepage customer reviews are
  sample placeholders pending verified customer feedback.
- Canonical URLs, og:url and the sitemap point at https://nivoram.com.
